cohort: 200 early booked (before 10 weeks) singleton pregnant women at the department of obstetrics and gynaecology at Ramakrishna Mission Seva Pratishthan, Vivekananda Institute of Medical Sciences, Kolkata.
finding: Antenatal weight gain was significantly related to pregestational BMI, with increased antenatal complications and caesarean section rates associated with obesity but not total antenatal weight gain, while birth weight was related to total antenatal weight gain.
birth_weight: Varied, but significantly related to total antenatal weight gain
